title.en: SGV dining guide: dumplings, noodles, cafes, and family meals
title.zh: 聖蓋博谷餐飲指南：餃子、麵食、茶餐廳與家庭聚餐

excerpt.en: Eater LA's SGV guide gives readers a concrete restaurant map for Alhambra, Arcadia, Monterey Park, San Gabriel, Rowland Heights, and nearby family dining corridors.
excerpt.zh: Eater LA 的聖蓋博谷指南，為讀者整理 Alhambra、Arcadia、Monterey Park、San Gabriel、Rowland Heights 與周邊家庭餐飲走廊。

body.en: The SGV guide centers the places ChineseLosAngeles readers actually use: Alhambra, Arcadia, Monterey Park, San Gabriel, West Covina, Rowland Heights, and nearby corridors east of downtown LA.
body.zh: 這份 SGV 指南聚焦 ChineseLosAngeles 讀者真正會去的地方：Alhambra、Arcadia、Monterey Park、San Gabriel、West Covina、Rowland Heights，以及洛杉磯市中心以東的周邊走廊。

body.en: The current Eater LA update adds places such as Good Alley, Banh Mi Hoa Phat, Thumbling, Mongolian Homemade Pie, and Lulala Lemon Tea, alongside Sichuan, Cantonese, Vietnamese, Malaysian, and Japanese options.
body.zh: 目前 Eater LA 更新加入 Good Alley、Banh Mi Hoa Phat、Thumbling、Mongolian Homemade Pie 與 Lulala Lemon Tea，並涵蓋川菜、粵菜、越南、馬來西亞與日式選擇。

body.en: Use it as a weekend shortlist: dumplings, hand-pulled noodles, Hong Kong-style cafes, omakase, tea shops, and family restaurants. Check the linked map for addresses, hours, and updates before going.
body.zh: 可把它當作週末短清單：餃子、手拉麵、港式茶餐廳、omakase、茶飲店與家庭餐館。出發前請用來源地圖確認地址、營業時間與更新。

label.zh: Eater LA 聖蓋博谷餐廳指南

title.en: SGV transit watch: why corridor planning matters
title.zh: 聖蓋博谷交通觀察：為什麼走廊規劃值得關注

excerpt.en: SGV corridor planning can change how families move between downtown LA, Alhambra, Monterey Park, San Gabriel, Pasadena, Pomona, and job centers.
excerpt.zh: 聖蓋博谷走廊規劃可能改變家庭往返洛杉磯市中心、Alhambra、Monterey Park、San Gabriel、Pasadena、Pomona 與工作中心的方式。

body.en: Urbanize LA's transit brief explains why SGV transportation planning remains active: money left after the dropped SR-60 rail extension is being studied for new bus, rail, and fixed-guideway options.
body.zh: Urbanize LA 的交通摘要說明了為何 SGV 交通規劃仍在推進：SR-60 軌道延伸取消後留下的資金，正被研究是否可用於新的公車、軌道與固定導向路線。

body.en: The alternatives include Valley Boulevard, SR-60, I-10, Garvey, Atlantic, Rosemead, Azusa, Citrus, and Metrolink concepts. Some are rapid bus or BRT ideas; others look at light rail or commuter rail upgrades.
body.zh: 方案涉及 Valley Boulevard、SR-60、I-10、Garvey、Atlantic、Rosemead、Azusa、Citrus 與 Metrolink 構想。有些是快速公車或 BRT，有些則評估輕軌或通勤鐵路升級。

body.en: For readers, the practical question is simple: does a proposal improve school runs, elder care trips, restaurant access, or commutes across SGV cities? Use the SGVCOG study link for project details.
body.zh: 對讀者而言，實際問題很直接：方案是否改善接送上學、長者照護出行、餐館可達性或跨 SGV 城市通勤？詳情請看 SGVCOG 研究連結。

title.en: LA Chinese community services: legal, language, and family anchors
title.zh: 洛杉磯華人社區服務：法律、語言與家庭支點

excerpt.en: Chinatown Service Center, AJSOCAL, and the Chinese American Museum give readers practical service, legal, and cultural starting points in Los Angeles.
excerpt.zh: 華埠服務中心、AJSOCAL 與洛杉磯華美博物館，為讀者提供洛杉磯服務、法律與文化資源的實用起點。

body.en: Chinatown Service Center is a practical first stop for health, social services, family support, and language-access needs. Its locations page helps readers move from a summary to an office or program.
body.zh: 華埠服務中心是查找健康、社福、家庭支持與語言服務的實用入口。它的據點頁可幫助讀者從摘要進一步找到辦公室或服務項目。

body.en: Asian Americans Advancing Justice Southern California adds legal and civic-rights help for immigrants, workers, families, and community organizations. That is the next link to check when a problem needs trusted guidance.
body.zh: 南加州亞美公義促進中心提供移民、勞工、家庭與社區組織所需的法律與公民權益協助。遇到需要可信指引的問題時，這是下一個應查看的來源。

body.en: The Chinese American Museum rounds out the map with history and culture near El Pueblo and Union Station. Together, these links point readers to LA institutions with service desks, visit pages, and clear next steps.
body.zh: 洛杉磯華美博物館則在 El Pueblo 與 Union Station 附近補上歷史與文化脈絡。這些連結指向有服務窗口、參觀資訊與清楚下一步的洛杉磯機構。

title.en: LAX and city notices before family travel
title.zh: 家庭出行前應查看的 LAX 與市府通知

excerpt.en: LAX and Los Angeles city updates help families verify terminal traffic, traveler advisories, construction, public-safety notices, and service changes.
excerpt.zh: LAX 與洛杉磯市府更新可幫助家庭核對航站樓交通、旅客提醒、施工、公共安全通知與服務變化。

body.en: For LA Chinese families, LAX is often where international arrivals, student flights, business trips, and elder pickups converge. Official airport updates help avoid surprises around terminals, traffic, and construction.
body.zh: 對洛杉磯華人家庭來說，LAX 經常連著國際抵達、學生航班、商務旅行與長者接送。官方機場更新可幫助避開航站樓、交通與施工上的意外。

body.en: The LAX Media Center is useful for airport programs, road work, traveler advisories, and operations news. The Mayor's news page adds citywide safety, service, and policy announcements.
body.zh: LAX Media Center 適合查看機場項目、道路工程、旅客提醒與營運消息。市長新聞頁則補上全市安全、服務與政策公告。

body.en: Check both before a major pickup, flight connection, or permit-sensitive city errand. Official links are slower than social posts, but they are where details can be verified.
body.zh: 大型接送、轉機或涉及許可的市府事項前，兩者都應查看。官方連結通常比社群貼文慢，但細節最能在那裡核實。
